findings.current: *Perhaps it’s fortunate that he found out even now.*
findings.defect: The direct thought changes the implied subject from Jeok Cheongang himself to an ambiguous third person, most naturally Jin Wikyung, who has not yet learned the relevant fact.
findings.rationale: This is Jeok Cheongang’s internal thought about his own belated discovery of Jin Taekyung’s extraordinary constitution.
findings.replacement: *Perhaps it was fortunate that I found out now.*

findings.current: “It’s also how long it took a Third Rate pleasure-house loafer to become a Peak master.”
findings.defect: The compound “pleasure-house loafer” is unnatural and obscures the explicit action that Taekyung habitually frequented pleasure houses.
findings.rationale: 들락거리던 means he regularly went in and out of pleasure houses; it does not describe a type of loafer associated with such a place.
findings.replacement: “It’s also how long it took a Third Rate wastrel who frequented pleasure houses to become a Peak master.”
findings.source: “기루나 들락거리던 삼류 한량이 절정 고수가 되기까지 걸린 시간이기도 하지요.”

findings.current:
“I called you ages ago. Why are you only coming now?”

“…”

“I’d hardly call this coming right away.
findings.defect: Taekyung’s spoken claim that he came immediately is omitted, even though it directly prompts Jeok Cheongang’s rebuttal.
findings.rationale: 바로 온 건데요 is explicit dialogue, not silent hesitation, and establishes the exchange’s setup and punchline.
findings.replacement:
“I called you ages ago. Why are you only coming now?”

“…I came right away.”

“I’d hardly call this coming right away.
findings.source:
“부른 지가 언젠데 이제야 오는 게냐?”

“……바로 온 건데요.”

내 대답에 적천강이 코웃음 쳤다.

findings.current: “No, nothing. The liquor tastes so good that I lost track of what I was saying.”
findings.defect: The translation invents an explanation about losing track of what he was saying; the Korean gives only a hurried, trailing excuse about the liquor tasting good.
findings.rationale: 그만 leaves the excuse understated and does not say that Taekyung forgot what he was saying.
findings.replacement: “No. The liquor just tastes so good, that’s all.”

findings.current: When I nodded, Ak Bulgun stroked his chin.
findings.defect: The physical action is altered: Ak Bulgun strokes his beard, not his chin.
findings.rationale: 턱수염 specifically means a beard or chin whiskers, and 쓸었다 describes stroking them.
findings.replacement: When I nodded, Ak Bulgun stroked his beard.
findings.source: 내가 고개를 끄덕이자 악불군이 턱수염을 쓸었다.

findings.current: With a burst of scorching heat, alcohol toxicity so potent it made my vision swim erupted into the room.
findings.defect: “Alcohol toxicity erupted into the room” is unnatural English and fails to convey the physically emitted blast of overpowering alcohol fumes.
findings.rationale: 주독 is emitted together with the heat and immediately overwhelms Taekyung; the replacement preserves that mechanism without the clinical and physically incoherent “alcohol toxicity.”
findings.replacement: Along with a burst of scorching heat came alcohol fumes so overpowering that my vision swam.
findings.source: 뜨거운 열기와 함께 순간 눈앞이 아찔해질 정도의 주독(酒毒)이 뿜어져 나온다.

summary: Two meaningful subject/dialogue errors and four localized fidelity or wording issues.
